run_grpo_training: run GRPO training on a language model with reward functions and a dataset
build_grpo_trainer: build a GRPO trainer with reward functions, model, and dataset for RLHF fine-tuning
create_reward_functions: create reward functions from a registry including accuracy, reasoning, and format rewards
configure_grpo_parser: configure an argparse parser for GRPO training with script, model, and dataset arguments
save_grpo_model: save and optionally push a trained GRPO model to the Hugging Face Hub
